attchmntText: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 14, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 5 equity shares of Rs. 2 each.
voiceSummary: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved subdividing one equity share of Rs. 10 face value into five shares of Rs. 2 face value. This action is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot and regulatory approvals. The company also approved altering the Memorandum of Association to reflect this change. A draft postal ballot notice is prepared, and M/s SCS and Co. LLP is appointed as the scrutinizer. National Securities Depository Limited is appointed as the remote e-voting agency. The record date for the share split will be intimated later. The board meeting concluded on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Regulations 41(4) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 ( SEBI ICDR Regulations ); please find enclosed herewith the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026, in relation to utilization of the proceeds raised through issuance of equity shares by way of the Initial Public Offer (IPO) of the Company.
voiceSummary: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company raised gross proceeds of Rs. 4,107.10 million. The report confirms that all utilization is as per the disclosures in the Offer Document. There are no deviations from the objects of the issue. The total amount utilized stands at Rs. 1,595.28 million. The unutilized balance is Rs. 2,511.82 million. Funds for the acquisition of Dry Bulk Carriers remain unutilized. The company has invested unutilized proceeds in fixed deposits with DCB Bank and Jana Small Finance Bank.

attchmntText: Disclosure regarding completion of Offer for Sale of Equity Shares by Promoters of the Company. In continuation of the intimations dated November 02, 2026 and November 03, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Offer for Sale (OFS) of equity shares of face value of ₹10 each of the Company by the Promoters, namely, Mr. Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Mr. Jitendrakumar Haridas Lal (Selling Promoters), was undertaken through the stock exchange mechanism on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE).
Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Offer for sale by the promoters'.

Newspaper publication of Notice of the proposed offer for sale of equity shares of face value of ₹10 each of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited (the Company) by its promoters (Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Jitendra Haridas Lal) (the Seller) through the stock exchange mechanism.

Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed offer for sale of equity shares of a face value of ₹ 10 each (the  Equity Shares ) of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited (the  Company ), by its Promoters namely Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Jitendra Haridas Lal, through the stock exchange mechanism in accordance with the relevant circulars issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (the  SEBI ) in this regard'.

Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Jitendra Haridas Lal have informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale up to 30,00,000 shares of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited. Date and time of the opening of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: November 03, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: November 03, 2026 at 3:30 p.m.; Date and time of the opening of the offer for Retail Investors: November 04, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Retail Investors: November 04, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. The Sale shall continue to take place on a separate window of the Stock Exchanges commencing at 9:15 a.m. and shall close at 3:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on the same date. The Floor Price for the Offer shall be INR 835/- (Rupees Eight Hundred and Thirty Five only).
